summary: Fail: checker rule N-R1 fails on four areas (docks-east 294, lantern-west 289, rocket-west 273, harbour-east 270 m; reach 250). Vantage's blocking handoff to Datum already records it. Datum's note justifies dropping T2 with reach that is wrong. All other checks pass. Timetable is plausible: time-only boarding, no fare, open questions go to Motive. Open: stale notes.why for Aster; retiring old loops needs Sky's OK.

faults.fault: Datum's note drops T2 and offers no other coverage, saying existing stops reach Docks, Harbour and Lantern "within about 255 m". That breaks standards.transit.reach (250 m), and the checker (N-R1) shows docks-east at 294 m, lantern-west at 289 m, rocket-west at 273 m and harbour-east at 270 m. The reason for holding back further line coverage is therefore false.
faults.fix: Remove the reach claim. Add line coverage that brings every plot within 250 m of a stop or station: a tram or sky rail branch near x ±260, e.g. Harbour Road / Sunset Way, with a legal turn or loop. Then hand it to Vantage for stops and to Pulse for a timetable.
